source_claim: AlphaEvolve-style evolutionary memory should reuse failed proposal evidence through durable, searchable, and semantically meaningful memory rather than only bounded run-local diagnostics
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve persists run-local failure_history.jsonl rows, validates them with a strict loader, stores failure fingerprints and repetition counts, summarizes changed files, file deltas, evaluation and stage errors, renders bounded prompt-visible failure memory with configurable filters, emits runtime.history.failure_index, and summarizes failure reuse in proposal lifecycle reports. It does not claim durable cross-run failure tables, semantic failed-proposal retrieval, learned repetition avoidance, replayable failed-mutation payloads, failure-aware sampling policy, or cross-run failure-index migrations.
